title: Refuse Bash comments in qualified literal-pipe argv proof
outcome: A word-leading unquoted Bash comment cannot qualify as a literal-pipe argument vector or claim a filter identity the shell discarded.
acceptance: Refuse word-leading unquoted # in the known-Bash qualified grammar while preserving quoted # and ordinary non-comment argument spellings where supported.
Add Unknown/Bash controls for comment-containing literal-pipe lines and update the refusal docs.
Focused tests and independent review cover the change.
